STEERING — Power Steering (Gear Housing)                                SR-63

6. REMOVE RACK GUIDE SPRING CAP LOCK NUT
Using SST, remove the rack guide spring cap lock nut.
SST 09612-24014 (09617-24020)

[Diagram showing SST tool removing lock nut]

7. REMOVE RACK GUIDE SPRING CAP
Using SST, remove the rack guide spring cap.
SST 09612-24014 (09612-10022)

[Diagram showing SST tool removing spring cap]

8. REMOVE RACK GUIDE SPRING, RACK GUIDE AND SEAT

[Diagram showing removal of rack guide spring and components]

9. REMOVE BEARING GUIDE LOCK NUT
Using SST, remove the lock nut.
SST 09612-24014 (09617-24020)

[Diagram showing SST tool removing bearing guide lock nut]

10. REMOVE BEARING GUIDE NUT
Using SST, remove the bearing guide nut.
SST 09612-24014 (09612-10022)

11. REMOVE DUST COVER

[Diagram showing SST tool and dust cover removal]
